participation.context: Kept the morning for the desk and left the horn half full.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Boiled the ink and named the twopence, the threepence, and the short loaf.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Brought the ewer, moved the cat once, and asked which play it was.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Already gone to Norton Folgate. He did not speak.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Named by Alse, for the day he wore the gown. He was not in the house.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

story.body: You left the horn unfilled and named Titus at two. You did not send the letter, and you did not ask a price you had not been told.

title: Stayed in while Monday's ink boiled
